derivation_method: low_medium=95th pctile legit; medium_high=F1-optimal calibrated threshold; high_critical=75th pctile of fraud scores, bounded to [medium_high+0.02, 0.99]
prior_bug: v1 used medium_high+0.15 unbounded, producing an unreachable 1.04 threshold since calibrated scores are capped at 1.0. Fixed with a percentile-of-fraud-scores anchor and an explicit 0.99 cap.
